tori-cs: I'll own customer smoke & quality checks; will prepare a 40-prompt eval and run regressions during soak.

ops-bot: Ticket CS-8099 created: owners raj-infra, mike-sre, tori-cs; dry-run (shadow) scheduled 2024-11-11T09:00:00-08:00.

raj-infra: Posting quick terraform snippet to ticket and will pre-warm KV cache with 12k prefixes.

mike-sre: Load plan (phased): warm 10m @300rps, soak 30m @950rps, 4x burst spikes to 3.5k rps. I'll push vegeta scripts to CS-8099.

elaine-cs: Owners confirmed. I'll send go/no-go checklist 48h before. Ping me for blockers. :rocket:
